sentences.text: No skull has been recovered for Shixinggia, but the species is known from a significant amount of post-cranial material.
Shixinggia measured approximately 1.50 meters in length.
Along with the more advanced Heyuannia, Shixinggia is one of the few oviraptorosaurs discovered in China.
The genus Shixinggia was named after Shixing County in Guangdong, China, where its fossils were found.
The authority for the genus Shixinggia is Lu & Zhang, 2005.
Lü and colleagues described the Shixinggia specimen as an oviraptorosaur, noting it could potentially be a caenagnathid.
Shixinggia is classified within the parent group Heyuanninae.
Shixinggia belongs to the family Oviraptoridae.
Shixinggia lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 70 million years ago in the Maastrichtian stage, with a time range estimated from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
